neighbours.label: physics of a change of state: fires on the word leading into 'phase' / 'transition' or the change itself (undergoes ⟦a⟧ phase transition, when water ⟦changes⟧ state, insulator-to-metal ⟦transition⟧)
fire: At the critical temperature the magnet undergoes a phase transition and loses its order.
Energy is released at the moment when steam changes state and becomes liquid water.
Under high pressure the crystal undergoes a phase change to a denser form.
Near absolute zero, helium undergoes a phase transition into a superfluid.
The latent heat is absorbed while the wax changes phase from solid to liquid.
As the early universe cooled, the plasma went through a phase transition.
Below this temperature the alloy undergoes a transition to a superconducting state.
The temperature stays constant while the ice changes state into water.
quiet: At the annual meeting the manager undergoes a long review and keeps his post.
Energy is wasted at the moment when drivers brake hard and then speed up.
Under high pressure the pipe began to leak at the welded joint.
Near the old harbour, the river flows slowly into the bay.
The heat is absorbed while the wall stands in the afternoon sun.
As the early settlers moved west, the towns went through a political transition.
Below this floor the building has a second phase of offices under construction.
The temperature stays constant while the fan runs in the room.

notes: Probing: 'undergoes a phase transition' 0.75 (on ' a'), 'ice changes state' 0.74, 'insulator-to-metal transition' 0.32; 'political transition' 0.00, 'second phase of the building project' 0.01, liquid cooling without a change of state 0.14. The output direction promotes phase/transition, and the - pole promotes z (x, y, ⟦and⟧ z).
